LESSON: CHRISTIAN VALUES

Grade: Grade 3
Subject: CHRISTIAN RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
Strand: Thankfulness By the end of the Sub strand, the learner ● Learners to recite Psal
Topic 4.3: Christian Values

SECTION 1: WELCOME

Hello! This is a study lesson on Christian Values. Read the explanation, follow every worked example, then do the practice. This is original CBC Learn content written from KICD outcomes — not a copy of a commercial textbook.

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

By the end of this lesson, you will be able to:

1. Explain the main ideas in Christian Values
2. Give Kenyan examples for Christian Values
3. Practise Christian Values at school and at home

SECTION 3: STUDY NOTES (READ AND LEARN)

WHAT YOU ARE LEARNING: CHRISTIAN VALUES
This lesson teaches Christian Values for Grade 3 CHRISTIAN RELIGIOUS EDUCATION.

STUDY STEPS
1. Explain the main ideas in Christian Values
   Practise this until you can do it without help.
2. Give Kenyan examples for Christian Values
   Practise this until you can do it without help.
3. Practise Christian Values at school and at home
   Practise this until you can do it without help.

HOW TO SHOW UNDERSTANDING
Explain the idea in your own words, give one Kenyan example, then complete the practice tasks.

SECTION 4: QUICK EXAMPLES

Example 1: Describe Christian Values using something at your school.

Example 2: Give a home/community example from your county.

Example 3: Teach a younger child one idea from this lesson in simple words.

SECTION 5: PRACTICE NOW

1. Underline the key ideas about Christian Values above.
2. Explain Christian Values to a parent using one local example.
3. Write or draw three things that prove you understand Christian Values.

SECTION 6: WORK TO DO (HOME / REVISION)

1. Write five sentences about Christian Values with school or home examples.
2. Answer: Why is Christian Values important for a Grade 3 learner?
3. Prepare a one-minute oral presentation for a parent or teacher.

SECTION: REMEMBER

1. Explain the main ideas in Christian Values
2. Give Kenyan examples for Christian Values
3. Practise Christian Values at school and at home

Now complete the Revision Quiz. Open Answers only after you finish.

— CBC Learn · Original study notes from KICD outcomes (Strategy 2)
